post.summary: This API copies a campaign within a country or from one country to other country(s) within a region. When campaigns are copied to different countries, this API converts your budget to the local currency, matches products, suggests bids and translates negative keywords. This API can currently only match up to 1,500 products. If your campaign has more than 1,500 products, we will only submit 1,500 of these products for matching
